text:
Kara: Quick SEO/launch note — we need sitemap priority, robots rules, canonical decisions, redirects, and inbound tagging for the webinar + benchmark hub. Can someone take sitemap + robots?

Dev: I can. Thoughts: include webinar landing in top-level sitemap with priority 0.8 and changefreq=weekly until one week post event. Block any staging or legacy tag pages in robots.txt. Also add the recording URL to the video sitemap after publish.

Luca: Canonical decision: canonicalize to /resources/webinars/inference-economics (keeps taxonomy tidy). If there are tag pages that surface the same content, add rel=canonical on the tag duplicates, not redirects.

Maya: Redirects owner here : I'll create a one-to-one 301 map and avoid chains. Draft (Netlify _redirects):
```
/old_event/inference-2024    /resources/webinars/inference-economics   301
/webinar-inference-landing   /resources/webinars/inference-economics   301
/posts/inference-benchmarks  /benchmarks/inference-economics         301
```
Preserve query params and ensure no 302s.

Robin: Inbound tagging & routing: use utm_campaign=inference_launch_q3 and hidden field source=webinar. HubSpot: create workflow that tags leads webinar_inference_q3, sets MQL if attended OR watched recording + viewed >2 pages, and assigns to AE queue if company_size > 25. Also, add auto-note to each contact with original landing path.

Kara: Sitemap + robots notes — add hreflang only if we publish translated landing pages. Otherwise keep a single canonical. Also submit sitemap to GSC after PR merges. Can you add a short checklist for sitemap submission?

Dev: Checklist for sitemap submission: 1) PR merged, 2) staging link removed from sitemap, 3) sitemap.xml updated with new URLs + priorities, 4) submit sitemap in GSC, 5) monitor coverage report for 48h.

Maya: Internal linking plan: add 2 contextual links from /docs/inference/overview and /benchmarks/latency-cost, plus a banner CTA on the docs hub. Use anchor text variations: "webinar: inference economics", "reduce inference cost". Avoid sitewide footer links that look spammy.

Luca: Schema: Event + VideoObject + FAQ. Keep JSON-LD minimal but include startDate, virtualLocation.url, and video contentUrl. Example small snippet for VideoObject to paste in head: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"VideoObject","name":"Inference webinar recording","uploadDate":"2026-07-15T12:00:00Z","contentUrl":"https://redwood.ai/resources/webinars/inference-economics/recording"} (paste as JSON-LD).

SEO Bot: Crawl scheduled at 2065435800 — will report missing sitemap entries, redirect chains, robots exclusions, and schema errors.

Robin: For analytics sanity: preserve utm_source and utm_medium, and make sure server-side redirects don't strip UTM params. We'll validate in GA and HubSpot.

Kara: Great. Maya/Dev/Luca/Robin own the items. Please update the launch board with PR links and ping me once sitemap is submitted and SEO Bot returns clean. Thanks! :rocket:
